scenes.text: FINE! Five hundred dollars! TAKE IT!
scenes.sticker: SHE PAID $500 TO PROVE A POINT

scenes.text: Psst. Exclusive investment club. Double your money in one week.
Oh, wait... it's not for piggy banks.
It's for SERIOUS investors. You could never afford the entry fee.
Five hundred. In gift cards. Today only.
I have five hundred dollars! I'll show you!
He said I can't afford it!
That's the trick. He insulted you so you'd want to prove him wrong.
Uh... the club closes in ten seconds!
Guaranteed money. Gift cards. A countdown. Three red flags.
Wait... he insulted me... to SELL me?!
Exactly. Real investments never rush you, and never ask for gift cards.
Okay, okay! VIP discount! Four ninety-nine!
